bills.summary: In a wider drug cost transparency bill, would have Medicaid use the same dispensing fee for 340B drugs as for other drugs, with leeway for health centers and family planning clinics, and would order a report on how 340B drugs are paid for and who benefits.

bills.title: AN ACT RELATING TO BUSINESSES AND PROFESSIONS -- DEFENDING AFFORDABLE PRESCRIPTION DRUG COSTS ACT
bills.summary: Bars insurers and pharmacy benefit managers, but not Medicaid, from paying less or setting different terms for 340B drugs, and bars drug makers from blocking delivery to contract pharmacies. Each covered entity must file a yearly public report on its 340B costs, payments and use of savings.

bills.title: DENTAL INSURANCE ASSIGNABILITY
bills.summary: Bars drug makers from limiting the purchase or delivery of 340B drugs to covered entities and their contract pharmacies. Covered entities must report 340B figures to lawmakers yearly, keep a policy against duplicate discounts and dispense 340B drugs only for outpatient care in the last 18 months.

bills.title: 340B ACCESS Act
bills.official_title: To amend the Public Health Service Act to reform the 340B drug pricing program, and for other purposes.
bills.summary: A broad rewrite of the program. Its sections cover contract pharmacies, hospital eligibility and child sites, what patients pay, Medicaid duplicate discounts, reporting by covered entities, a claims data clearinghouse, fees, and equal treatment of covered entities by payers.
